fundamentals.name: Arm Holdings plc
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Arm Holdings plc researches, develops, licenses, and markets central processing unit (CPU) intellectual property (IP), graphics processing unit IP, systems IP, compute subsystems (CSS), and associated software, tools and related services. The company provides a product portfolio, including CPU IP, GPU and neural processing unit (NPU) accelerators, system IP such as interconnects, compute platform products including pre-integrated CSSs, and development tools and software. The company serves semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), cloud service providers (CSPs), and organizations developing chips for end markets such as smartphones, consumer electronics, industrial IoT, embedded systems, cloud data centers, networking, automotive, and robotics. It provides its products and services in the United States, China, Japan, Taiwan, Korea, and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cambridge, United Kingdom. Arm Holdings plc operates as a subsidiary of SoftBank Group Corp.

judgment.summary: Arm Holdings is a high-growth company with exceptional margins and strong analyst backing, though its valuation is demanding.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 3.6%; next earnings date is 2026-07-29.
positives: Revenue growth of 20.1% YoY and earnings growth of 47.9% YoY indicate strong top and bottom-line expansion.
Gross margin of 97.5% and operating margin of 29.5% demonstrate significant pricing power and operational efficiency.
Quarterly earnings growth of 49.0% and analyst estimates for current Q and FY suggest continued positive momentum.
Strong liquidity with a current ratio of 6.00 and quick ratio of 5.83, alongside substantial free cash flow of $750.50M TTM.

negatives: Trailing P/E of 387.19 and forward P/E of 108.54 indicate a very high valuation.
PEG ratio of 3.01 suggests the stock may be overvalued relative to its earnings growth.
Price/Book of 42.76 and Price/Sales of 72.29 are exceptionally high, reflecting significant market expectations.
Debt/Equity ratio of 5.93 is high, although offset by strong cash reserves and free cash flow.
Beta of 3.79 indicates high volatility relative to the broader market.

news.paragraph: Arm Holdings experienced a notable pullback on June 10th, with shares falling 5% amid a broader selloff in mobile-chip stocks, despite Mizuho raising its price target on the stock. This comes as the company's stock has already seen significant gains year-to-date, with analysts projecting continued growth. The recent price action highlights the volatility associated with high-growth tech names, even with positive analyst sentiment.
